import gzip,json,collections
from factor_engine.tools.catalog_recipe_migration import migrate_catalog_recipe_formula
forms=changed=calls=0; by=collections.Counter()
with gzip.open("evidence/factor_catalog_20260915/input.jsonl.gz","rt") as f:
 for line in f:
  obj=json.loads(line); s=obj.get("formula")
  if not isinstance(s,str): continue
  forms+=1
  try: r=migrate_catalog_recipe_formula(s)
  except SyntaxError: continue
  if r.formula!=s: changed+=1
  calls+=len(r.changes)
  by.update(r.changes)
print("string_formulas",forms); print("changed_formulas",changed); print("changed_calls",calls)
for k,v in sorted(by.items()): print(k,v)
